name: CSC ROBO Drillcorpio Df self-navigating drilling robot
summary: Self-navigating drilling and anchor-installing robot for ceilings, floors and walls that drills holes from a CAD/BIM drilling plan and avoids rebar. Made in Hong Kong; a UK contractor announced a purchase for 2026.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found. CSC ROBO lists an enquiry address in Hong Kong; a UK firm (Beton Bauen) bought one for 2026.

specs.label: Navigation
specs.quote: After importing the CAD/BIM drawing to the tablet, the construction robot can drill the holes autonomously according to the drilling plan.

specs.label: Safety and avoidance
specs.quote: It included a collision avoidance system and rebar evasion function.

specs.label: Operation
specs.value: One-man operation, Wi-Fi remote and Android tablet

specs.label: Dust control
specs.quote: The machine also incorporate a dust control mechanism

notes: Arm = drilling unit; the robot also installs anchors automatically.
Drive type is not stated on the pages read; wheels are assumed for a floor-driving robot.

evidence.task: Drills holes and installs anchors autonomously from an imported drilling plan
evidence.note: UK contractor Beton Bauen announced an investment of almost 250,000 GBP to buy a Df, expected in service by summer 2026.
Robots in Construction lists 100 documented deployments across 4 companies; sites were not read. Shown as a claim because no project or site is named.
